final_reply:
All 6 of Priya's open deals are now at 20% probability.

| Opportunity | Stage | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hooli - Analytics Add-on | Value Proposition | 50% | 20% |
| Vandelay - Import Tracking | Qualification | 10% | 20% |
| Oceanic Shipping - Port Integration | Proposal/Price Quote | 75% | 20% |
| Stark Logistics - Warehouse Sensors | Proposal/Price Quote | 75% | 20% |
| Vandelay - Analytics Starter | Needs Analysis | 20% | 20% (already set, so I left it alone) |
| Wayne Enterprises - Training Package | Prospecting | 10% | 20% |

**Oceanic Shipping didn't update the first time.** The system said the change worked, but when I checked, the deal was still at 75%. I updated it again, and it now shows 20%. You may want to look at it again later in case something keeps changing it back.

The probability is now the same no matter what stage each deal is in. So the two Proposal/Price Quote deals went down from 75%, and the two early-stage deals went up from 10%. This will change Priya's weighted pipeline numbers.

4. Get explicit confirmation from the user before deleting more than 3 records.

Use the tools to look things up and make changes. If you need more information from the user, reply with your question instead of guessing. When you're done, reply with a brief summary of what you did or found.
